meta.title: PTS — Software for passenger transport: dispatch & work-time
meta.description: PTS is the software for passenger transport: plan routes, dispatch trips, track work time to German labor law. From 39 € per vehicle.

hero.h1: Dispatch your fleet in seconds — not hours.
hero.sub: PTS is the software for passenger transport. Plan routes, dispatch trips, track work time to German labor law — in one system, for chauffeur, taxi and medical transport fleets.
hero.meta: {days}-day free trial · month-to-month · onboarding in under {onboard} business days

features.h2: Assign trips with one click, not five phone calls.
features.body: PTS shows every vehicle, driver and trip on a shared timeline and flags conflicts before you assign. See at a glance who is free, who is on break and who is already driving.
list: Drag-and-drop assignment with real-time conflict checks
Recurring trips (school runs, dialysis, business shuttles) — set up once, run for months
Drivers receive trips automatically on the app — no paper, no phone call
Changes and cancellations reach drivers and clients in seconds

features.h2: Fewer empty miles. More revenue per shift.
features.body: PTS optimizes routes with live traffic and cuts empty miles by an average of 18 % after three months — with arrival times accurate to the minute.
list: Multi-stop optimization with client time windows
Live traffic from HERE and OSM, real-time ETA
Automatic re-planning on delay — driver and passenger notified
Kilometer report per order, driver and vehicle — straight to billing

features.h2: BAG-compliant records. No Excel. No paper.
features.body: PTS meets the German work-time tracking requirement per the BAG ruling of 13 Sep 2022 — per driver, per day, with a tamper-evident change log and direct export to DATEV.
list: One-tap start & stop in the driver app, works offline
Approval workflow for dispatcher and driver, versioned and auditable
Export to DATEV, Lexoffice and sevDesk

faq.h2: The most common questions before switching.

items.q: What does PTS cost per vehicle per month?
items.a: PTS starts at 39 € per vehicle per month on the Starter tier. Pro costs 69 € per vehicle per month and includes route optimization and DATEV export. Fleets of 25+ vehicles get individual Enterprise terms.
Typically under 5 business days. We migrate your master data (drivers, vehicles, customers) and train your team in two 90-minute sessions. Day five, you're live.

items.q: Is PTS GDPR-compliant? Is there a DPA?
items.a: Yes. PTS runs exclusively in German data centers (Frankfurt, ISO 27001). A data processing agreement per GDPR Art. 28 is ready to sign and comes with every contract.

items.q: Does the work-time tracking meet the BAG ruling of 13 Sep 2022?
items.a: Yes. PTS records start, end, breaks and duration per driver and per day. All changes are versioned and stored tamper-evidently. Records are BAG-ready and export as PDF.
PTS exports to DATEV payroll, Lexoffice, sevDesk and CSV. For taxi operators we integrate with Taxameter, TX-App and ISI-Fahrbetrieb. Client-side: SAP Concur, HRworks and an open REST API.

items.q: Does the driver app work offline?
items.a: Yes. The driver app stores orders and work-time offline and syncs automatically once signal returns. Supported on iOS and Android for the last three major versions.
Month-to-month. You pay per vehicle per month, no setup fee, no minimum term. Annual commitment gets a 15 % discount.
Yes. 14 days free, all features, no payment details required. After the trial you decide whether to sign — or cancel in one click.

demo.h2: 30 minutes. Your fleet. Live in PTS.
demo.body: We show you PTS with your actual workflows — not a generic demo. After the call you'll know whether PTS fits. No sales pressure.
